items.title: File Einspruch against amended income tax assessment 2025
items.quote: Sie können diesen Bescheid binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe mit dem Einspruch anfechten, der schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der erlassenden Stelle einzulegen ist.
items.computation: Letter dated (posting day) 31.12.2026 (Thursday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date given, so this is the posting day. Bekanntgabefiktion for tax offices (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, posted after 1 Jan 2025): delivery on the 4th day after posting, moved to the next working day if that 4th day is a Saturday, Sunday or holiday (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). Counting from 31.12.2026 (day 0, not counted): day 1 = 01.01.2027 (Fri, New Year's Day), day 2 = 02.01.2027 (Sat), day 3 = 03.01.2027 (Sun), day 4 = 04.01.2027 (Mon) → 04.01.2027 is a working day, so deemed delivery = 04.01.2027. One-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO, §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB): starts the day after delivery, ends one month later on the same-numbered day: 04.01.2027 + 1 month = 04.02.2027 (Thursday), which is not a weekend or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO.
